review: [Firefist Office Survivor] Gregor is a straightforward, simple, and strong Burn-centric ID. Gregor starts encounters with a resource called “District 12 Fuel” that can turn into “Overheating Fuel” and both are consumed by his skills to do more damage (and I mean a lot more damage) or spread Burn.
